name: Run SSH script
description: Run a multi-line script on a remote host over SSH. The script is sent on the standard input of the interpreter, so nothing is written to the remote disk.

script.description: Content of the script to run

interpreter.description: Interpreter reading the script on its standard input

host.description: Overrides the host set in the account

fail_on_error.description: Mark the action as failed when the exit code is not 0

host_key_fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the server's host key
